Comment: RecallIndia IngestStateMachine (SPEC section Ingest pipeline). Fetch -> Extract -> Normalise -> Diff -> Publish. Two CDSCO adapters, one Notice shape: cdsco_portal (live JSON, skips Extract) and cdsco_pdf (archive PDF: Textract TABLES primary, pdfplumber fallback). Diff/Publish are P03 placeholders.

Fetch.Comment: cdsco_portal: publicReportingMonths -> newest month -> filteredNsqDrugTable rows; output {adapter, month, rows_in}. cdsco_pdf: download the archive PDF to the raw bucket; output {adapter, pdf_url, pdf_s3_key}. Later tasks read these from $.fetch (handlers merge $.fetch/$.extract under top-level keys).

NeedsExtract.Comment: Portal rows are already tabular; only the PDF adapter goes through Extract.

Extract.Comment: Reads pdf_s3_key from $.fetch. Textract StartDocumentAnalysis TABLES (poll GetDocumentAnalysis) in try/except; on any error or <5 rows, pdfplumber extract_tables fallback. Output {rows, row_pages, rows_s3_key, engine, fallback_used}; rows are inlined under 200 KB and always mirrored to rows_s3_key.

Normalise.Comment: Reads adapter/month/pdf_s3_key/pdf_url from $.fetch and rows/row_pages/rows_s3_key from $.extract (portal: fetches rows itself). Bedrock (Nova Lite, temperature 0, strict JSON, batches of 25 rows) maps rows to Notice; header-keyword fallback. Upsert notices with source cdsco_nsq, adapter, row_ref ({page,row} PDF / {month,row} portal), pdf_s3_key. Output {adapter, month, pdf_s3_key, rows_in, notices_out, fallback_used}.

Diff.Comment: P03: count new vs existing notices for this run.

Publish.Comment: P03: write meta#cdsco.last_run + counts so the /ingest UI checklist and feed can read them.

Failed.Cause: A task failed after retries; see $.error
